definition_zh: 暴风雨；风暴；猛攻；怒气冲冲地走
definition_en: very bad weather with strong wind and rain, a violent outbreak, or to attack suddenly
core_image: 乌云压城，狂风掀起了海面
scene: 暴风雨掀翻了屋顶。The storm blew off the roof.
sceneCN: 这里 storm 是「暴风雨」（第 1 个义项）；句意：暴风雨掀翻了屋顶。

senses.title: Bad weather
senses.definition: very bad weather with strong wind and heavy rain
senses.definitionCN: 狂风暴雨的恶劣天气
senses.example: The storm blew off the roof.
senses.why: This is the basic weather sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的天气义项。

senses.title: A violent outbreak
senses.definition: a sudden violent show of feeling or protest
senses.definitionCN: 情绪或抗议的突然猛烈爆发
senses.example: A storm of protest followed.
senses.why: Weather becomes a picture for feelings.
senses.whyCN: 天气成为情绪的比喻。

senses.title: Attack suddenly
senses.definition: to attack a place suddenly and violently
senses.definitionCN: 突然而猛烈地攻击某地
senses.example: The soldiers stormed the gate.
senses.why: The force of weather becomes the force of attack.
senses.whyCN: 天气的威力转成攻击的威力。

senses.title: Leave in anger
senses.definition: to go somewhere in a very angry way
senses.definitionCN: 非常愤怒地走向某处
senses.example: She stormed out of the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她怒气冲冲地离开了房间。
senses.why: Anger moves like a storm.
senses.whyCN: 怒气像风暴一样移动。

intro.en: Storm is an old Germanic word for violent weather.
intro.cn: storm 是一个古老的日耳曼语词，指猛烈的天气。

items.en: The root named a violent rush.
Storm meant a tempest of wind and rain.
items.cn: storm 指风雨交加的暴风雨。

items.en: Storm also meant an attack.
Storm pictured outbreaks of feeling.
items.cn: storm 用来比喻情绪的爆发。

items.en: To storm out meant to leave in anger.
items.cn: storm out 意为怒气冲冲地离开。

note.en: Storm is compared with look-alike words and with words for violent weather.
note.cn: 把 storm 与形近词以及表示猛烈天气的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A storm is weather with a temper.
normalIntro.cn: storm 是带着脾气的天气。

normal.en: The storm blew off the roof.
A storm of protest followed.
The soldiers stormed the gate.
She stormed out of the room.
normal.cn: 她怒气冲冲地离开了房间。

normal.en: The ship weathered the storm.

abstract.en: A storm is the sky losing its patience.
abstract.cn: 风暴，是天空失去了耐心。

abstract.en: Anger is a storm that breaks inside a room.
abstract.cn: 愤怒，是在屋里爆发的风暴。

abstract.en: After every storm the air feels newly washed.
abstract.cn: 每场风暴过后，空气都像被重新洗过。

examples.en: The storm blew off the roof.
A storm of protest followed.
She stormed out of the room.
examples.cn: 她怒气冲冲地离开了房间。

dict_mnemonic.text: storm 是「暴风雨」，也指情绪或抗议的风暴；take by storm 是迅速攻占或风靡，storm out 是怒气冲冲地离开，weather the storm 是渡过难关。

root: 来自古英语 storm（风雨交加），与日耳曼语同源；由自然界的猛烈天气，引申为情绪与舆论的爆发，再引申为猛攻与愤然离去。

sensesIntro.en: Storm is violent weather, an outbreak of feeling, a sudden attack, or an angry exit.
sensesIntro.cn: storm 是猛烈天气、情绪爆发、突然猛攻，或愤然离开。

core.en: Force that arrives all at once.
core.cn: 一下子全部到来的力量。

branches.en: The storm blew off the roof.
branches.cn: 暴风雨掀翻了屋顶。

branches.en: A storm of protest followed.
branches.cn: 随后爆发了一片抗议。

branches.en: The soldiers stormed the gate.
branches.cn: 士兵们猛攻大门。

branches.en: She stormed out of the room.
branches.cn: 她怒气冲冲地离开了房间。

branches.en: The same anger sounds in protest and in footsteps.
branches.cn: 同样的怒气，响在抗议里，也响在脚步里。

intro.en: Storm takes endings and builds words for wild weather and feeling.
intro.cn: storm 加词尾，构成与恶劣天气和情绪相关的词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The troops were storming the hill.
A stormy night kept them indoors.
items.exampleCN: 暴风雨的夜晚让他们留在室内。

items.example: The storminess of the sea kept boats in port.
items.exampleCN: 海上的风暴使船只留在港内。

items.meaning: a warning of a coming storm

definition_en: a description of events, a news report, or a level of a building
core_image: 一盏灯下摊开的旧故事书
scene: 奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。Grandma tells us a story every night.
sceneCN: 这里 story 是「故事」（第 1 个义项）；句意：奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。

derivatives.zh: 有故事流传的；历史上有名的

senses.title: A told tale
senses.definition: a description of events, real or imagined
senses.definitionCN: 对真实或想象事件的叙述
senses.example: Grandma tells us a story every night.
senses.exampleCN: 奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。
senses.why: This is the basic sense of a tale.
senses.whyCN: 这是故事的基本义项。

senses.title: A news report
senses.definition: a report of events in a newspaper or broadcast
senses.definitionCN: 报纸或广播中的事件报道
senses.example: The paper ran the story on page one.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸把这条报道放在头版。
senses.why: News is a story told about real events.
senses.whyCN: 新闻就是关于真实事件的叙述。

senses.title: A level of a building
senses.definition: a level or floor of a building
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物的一层
senses.example: They live in a two-story house.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在一栋两层的房子里。
senses.why: Each floor once held painted scenes.
senses.whyCN: 古时每层楼常绘有图画故事。

intro.en: Story comes from Latin historia by way of French.
intro.cn: story 经法语来自拉丁语 historia。

items.en: Historia meant inquiry and narrative.
Estorie meant a tale or account.
Story named a tale and a history.
Story named a news report.
Story named a floor of a building.

note.en: Story is compared with look-alike words and with words for tales.
note.cn: 把 story 与形近词以及表示故事的词作比较。

entries.definition: a bright point in the night sky

normalIntro.en: A story gives events a shape you can carry.
normalIntro.cn: 故事把事件整理成能带走的形状。

normal.en: Grandma tells us a story every night.
normal.cn: 奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。

normal.en: He read a short story on the train.
normal.cn: 他在火车上读了一篇短篇小说。

normal.en: The paper ran the story on page one.
normal.cn: 报纸把这条报道放在头版。

normal.en: They live in a two-story house.
normal.cn: 他们住在一栋两层的房子里。

normal.en: The story goes that she never returned.

abstract.en: A story is a room built out of words.
abstract.cn: 故事，是用词语搭起来的一间屋子。

abstract.en: We are all stories still being written.
abstract.cn: 我们都还是正在被书写的故事。

abstract.en: The same events tell a different story to each listener.
abstract.cn: 同样的事件，对每个听者讲出不同的故事。

examples.en: Grandma tells us a story every night.
examples.cn: 奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。

examples.en: The paper ran the story on page one.
examples.cn: 报纸把这条报道放在头版。

examples.en: They live in a two-story house.
examples.cn: 他们住在一栋两层的房子里。

dict_mnemonic.text: story 是「故事、小说」；tell a story 是讲故事，news story 是新闻报道，two-story house 是两层的房子，词尾的 story 在美式英语里就是「楼层」。

root: 经古法语 estorie 来自拉丁语 historia（探究、叙述）；由对真实事件的记述，兼指虚构的故事，再引申为新闻篇幅与建筑物的楼层。

sensesIntro.en: Story is a tale, a news report, or a level of a building.
sensesIntro.cn: story 是故事、新闻报道，或建筑物的楼层。

core.en: Events arranged so they can be told.
core.cn: 被整理成可以讲述的事件。

branches.en: Grandma tells us a story every night.
branches.cn: 奶奶每晚给我们讲一个故事。

branches.en: The paper ran the story on page one.
branches.cn: 报纸把这条报道放在头版。

branches.en: They live in a two-story house.
branches.cn: 他们住在一栋两层的房子里。

branches.en: News is the same telling art used on facts.
branches.cn: 新闻，是把讲故事的技艺用在事实上。

branches.en: Each floor of the old house had its own story.
branches.cn: 那栋老房子的每一层都有自己的故事。

intro.en: Story multiplies to stories and builds words for telling.
intro.cn: story 的复数变 stories，并构成与讲述相关的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source historia meant inquiry and narrative.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源 historia 意为探究与叙述。

items.example: He read a short story on the train.
items.exampleCN: 他在火车上读了一篇短篇小说。

items.example: The news story was on page one.
They live in a two-story house.
items.exampleCN: 他们住在一栋两层的房子里。

definition_zh: 直的；笔直的；正直的；直接地
definition_en: not bent or curved, honest and direct, or in a direct way
core_image: 一条笔直延伸到地平线的公路
scene: 这条路又长又直。The road is long and straight.
sceneCN: 这里 straight 是「直的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这条路又长又直。

senses.title: Not bent
senses.definition: not bent or curved
senses.definitionCN: 不弯不曲的
senses.example: Draw a straight line.
senses.why: This is the basic shape sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的形状义项。

senses.title: Honest
senses.definition: honest and direct in speech or behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 言语或行为诚实直接
senses.example: Give me a straight answer.
senses.why: A straight line becomes a straight character.
senses.whyCN: 笔直的线，变成了正直的品格。

senses.title: Directly
senses.definition: in a direct way, without delay or detour
senses.definitionCN: 径直地，不耽搁也不绕路
senses.example: Go straight home after school.
senses.why: The adjective works as an adverb.
senses.whyCN: 形容词同时用作副词。

intro.en: Straight is the old past participle of stretch.
intro.cn: straight 原是 stretch（伸展）的过去分词。

items.en: The root meant to stretch tight.
Streht meant stretched out.
Straight named a line without bends.
Straight came to mean honest.
Straight worked as an adverb.
items.cn: straight 也用作副词，表示直接地。

note.en: Straight is compared with look-alike words and with words for directness.
note.cn: 把 straight 与形近词以及表示直接与正直的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Straight is a line that refuses to turn.
normalIntro.cn: straight 是一条拒绝转弯的线。

normal.en: The road is long and straight.
Draw a straight line.
Go straight home after school.
Give me a straight answer.
He kept a straight face.

abstract.en: A straight line wastes no motion.
abstract.cn: 直线不浪费动作。

abstract.en: A straight word can still cut.
abstract.cn: 坦白的话，同样能割伤人。

abstract.en: The shortest path is often the bravest.
abstract.cn: 最短的路，往往最需要勇气。

examples.en: The road is long and straight.
Give me a straight answer.
Go straight home after school.

dict_mnemonic.text: straight 是「直的」，也指「正直」和「直接地」；straight line 是直线，straight away 是立刻，keep a straight face 是板着脸忍住不笑。

root: 来自古英语 streht，是 streccan（伸展）的过去分词；由「被拉直、伸展开」的形象，引申为不弯曲、坦率正直，又兼作副词表示直接地。

sensesIntro.en: Straight is not bent, honest, or done directly.
sensesIntro.cn: straight 是不弯曲的、诚实的，或径直的。

core.en: A line pulled tight between two points.
core.cn: 两点之间被拉紧的一条线。

branches.en: Draw a straight line.
branches.cn: 画一条直线。

branches.en: Give me a straight answer.
branches.cn: 给我一个坦率的回答。

branches.en: Go straight home after school.
branches.cn: 放学后直接回家。

branches.en: A straight line and a straight character share one shape.
branches.cn: 笔直的线与正直的人，共用一种形状。

branches.en: To speak straight is to take the short road.
branches.cn: 把话直说，就是走那条短的路。

intro.en: Straight takes comparison and builds words for straightness.
intro.cn: straight 有比较级，并构成表示笔直与直接的词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The straightness of the road surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 这条路之笔直让我们吃惊。

definition_zh: 简单的；直截了当的；坦率的；正直的
definition_en: easy to understand or do, or honest and direct
core_image: 一条没有岔口、直接通向目标的通道
scene: 他的解释简单明了。His explanation was straightforward.
sceneCN: 这里 straightforward 是「简单明了」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他的解释简单明了。

senses.title: Easy to follow
senses.definition: easy to understand or do, with no complications
senses.definitionCN: 容易理解或完成，没有复杂之处
senses.example: The instructions are straightforward.
senses.why: A straight path is easy to walk.
senses.whyCN: 笔直的路容易走。

senses.title: Honest and direct
senses.definition: honest and direct in what one says or does
senses.definitionCN: 言行诚实而直接
senses.example: She gave a straightforward answer.
senses.exampleCN: 她给出了直截了当的回答。
senses.why: A straight line becomes an honest manner.
senses.whyCN: 笔直的线，成为坦率的作风。

intro.en: Straightforward joins straight and forward into one word.
intro.cn: straightforward 由 straight 与 forward 合成一个词。

items.en: Streht meant stretched out, not bent.
items.cn: streht 意为被拉直、不弯的。

items.en: Straight named a direct line.
Forward named the direction ahead.
The two words joined into one adjective.
items.cn: 两个词合成一个形容词。

items.en: It came to mean simple and honest.

note.en: Straightforward is compared with look-alike words and with words for simplicity and honesty.
note.cn: 把 straightforward 与形近词以及表示简单和诚实的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Straightforward means there is nothing to untangle.
normalIntro.cn: straightforward 就是说没有什么要解开的结。

normal.en: The instructions are straightforward.
She gave a straightforward answer.
normal.cn: 她给出了直截了当的回答。

normal.en: The process is quite straightforward.
He spoke in a straightforward manner.
Be straightforward about your needs.

abstract.en: A straightforward road is still a choice.
abstract.cn: 好走的路，也仍是一种选择。

abstract.en: Simplicity is not the same as shallowness.
abstract.cn: 简单，并不等于浅薄。

abstract.en: The most direct sentence can be the kindest.
abstract.cn: 最直接的那句话，可能最体贴。

examples.en: His explanation was straightforward.
She gave a straightforward answer.
examples.cn: 她给出了直截了当的回答。

examples.en: The process is quite straightforward.

dict_mnemonic.text: straightforward 是 straight 与 forward 的合成，字面是「径直向前」；由路径不绕弯，引申为事情简单，以及说话坦率正直。

root: 由 straight（直的）与 forward（向前）合成；由「不绕弯地径直向前」，引申为流程简单易懂，再引申为为人坦率、公正。

sensesIntro.en: Straightforward means easy to understand or honest and direct.
sensesIntro.cn: straightforward 表示简单易懂，或坦率正直。

core.en: A road with no turns to explain.
core.cn: 一条无需解释转弯的路。

branches.en: The instructions are straightforward.
branches.cn: 这些说明很简单。

branches.en: She gave a straightforward answer.
branches.cn: 她给出了直截了当的回答。

branches.en: A simple method and an honest word walk the same road.
branches.cn: 简单的方法与坦率的话，走的是同一条路。

branches.en: Direct speech saves everyone time.
branches.cn: 直说的话，为所有人省下时间。

branches.en: What is clear to do is easier to begin.
branches.cn: 清楚该怎么做，就更容易开始。

intro.en: Straightforward takes endings for manner and state.
intro.cn: straightforward 加词尾，构成方式与状态类副词和名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; both parts are Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，两部分都来自日耳曼语。

items.exampleCN: 她给出了直截了当的回答。

items.example: He spoke in a straightforward manner.

definition_en: to pull something tight, to make a great effort, to injure a muscle, or pressure and worry
core_image: 一根绷到极限、纤维起了毛边的绳子
scene: 绳子在重物下绷得紧紧的。The rope strained under the weight.
sceneCN: 这里 strain 是「拉紧」（第 1 个义项）；句意：绳子在重物下绷得紧紧的。

senses.title: Pull tight
senses.definition: to pull something tight or stretch it hard
senses.definitionCN: 把某物拉紧或用力拉伸
senses.example: The rope strained under the weight.
senses.exampleCN: 绳子在重物下绷得紧紧的。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Try very hard
senses.definition: to make a great effort to do something
senses.definitionCN: 为做某事付出很大努力
senses.example: She strained to hear him.
senses.why: Tightening the body becomes effort.
senses.whyCN: 绷紧身体，引申为用力。

senses.title: Injure a muscle
senses.definition: to injure a muscle by pulling it too hard
senses.definitionCN: 因用力过度而拉伤肌肉
senses.example: He strained his back.
senses.why: Too much pulling hurts the body.
senses.whyCN: 拉得过猛，身体就会受伤。

senses.title: Pressure and worry
senses.definition: pressure or worry caused by heavy demands
senses.definitionCN: 由沉重负担造成的压力或忧虑
senses.example: The strain of the journey tired them.
senses.exampleCN: 旅途的劳累让他们疲惫。
senses.why: Being pulled tight becomes being burdened.
senses.whyCN: 被拉紧，转指被压得紧绷。

intro.en: Strain comes from Latin stringere by way of French.
intro.cn: strain 经法语来自拉丁语 stringere。

items.en: Stringere meant to draw tight.
Estraindre meant to press or tighten.
Strain meant to stretch and to filter.
Strain named effort and injury.
Strain named pressure and worry.

note.en: Strain is compared with look-alike words and with words for effort and pressure.
note.cn: 把 strain 与形近词以及表示用力与压力的词作比较。

entries.definition: to pull out to full length

normalIntro.en: Strain is what happens when the pull exceeds the strength.
normalIntro.cn: strain 就是拉力超过强度时发生的事。

normal.en: The rope strained under the weight.
normal.cn: 绳子在重物下绷得紧紧的。

normal.en: She strained to hear him.
He strained his back lifting the box.
The long journey put a strain on them.
normal.cn: 长途旅行给他们造成了压力。

normal.en: The bridge is under strain.

abstract.en: A strained rope sings the loudest.
abstract.cn: 绷紧的绳子，唱得最响。

abstract.en: Some things break precisely because they held too long.
abstract.cn: 有些东西之所以断裂，正因为撑得太久。

abstract.en: Strain shows where the strength ends.
abstract.cn: 压力，标出了力量的边界。

examples.en: The rope strained under the weight.
examples.cn: 绳子在重物下绷得紧紧的。

examples.en: She strained to hear him.
The strain of the journey tired them.
examples.cn: 旅途的劳累让他们疲惫。

dict_mnemonic.text: strain 是「拉紧」，也指「尽力」「扭伤」和「压力」；strain a muscle 是拉伤肌肉，under strain 是处于压力下，put a strain on 是给某事造成压力。

root: 经古法语 estraindre 来自拉丁语 stringere（拉紧、束紧）；由绷紧绳索的物理动作，引申为用力、拉伤肌肉，再引申为精神与生活上的压力。

sensesIntro.en: Strain is to pull tight, to try hard, to injure a muscle, or pressure and worry.
sensesIntro.cn: strain 是拉紧、尽力、扭伤肌肉，或压力与忧虑。

core.en: A rope pulled past its comfort.
core.cn: 一根被拉过舒适限度的绳子。

branches.en: The rope strained under the weight.
branches.cn: 绳子在重物下绷得紧紧的。

branches.en: She strained to hear him.
branches.cn: 她使劲去听他说的话。

branches.en: He strained his back.
branches.cn: 他拉伤了背。

branches.en: The strain of the journey tired them.
branches.cn: 旅途的劳累让他们疲惫。

branches.en: A tight rope and a tired mind feel the same pull.

senses.title: Make physically stronger
senses.definition: to make a body, structure, or material stronger
senses.definitionCN: 使身体、结构或材料更强
senses.example: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
senses.why: This is added power in the body.
senses.whyCN: 这是给身体增加力量。

senses.title: Make a bond firmer
senses.definition: to make a relationship, position, or system more secure
senses.definitionCN: 使关系、地位或体系更稳固
senses.example: The visit strengthened ties between the two cities.
senses.exampleCN: 这次访问加强了两座城市之间的联系。
senses.why: Bonds can be braced like beams.
senses.whyCN: 关系也能像梁一样被加固。

senses.title: Make more convincing
senses.definition: to make an argument, feeling, or effect stronger
senses.definitionCN: 使论点、感受或效果更有力
senses.example: The new evidence strengthened her case.
senses.exampleCN: 新证据使她的论据更有力。
senses.why: A case stands like a structure and can be braced.
senses.whyCN: 论据像建筑一样立着，也能被加固。

intro.en: Strengthen is strength plus the verb ending -en.
intro.cn: strengthen 由 strength 加动词后缀 -en 构成。

items.en: Strengþu named power.
Strengthen meant to give strength.
items.cn: 中古英语 strengthen 意为赋予力量。

items.en: It described making the body stronger.
items.cn: 它用来描写让身体更强壮。

items.en: It spread to buildings and systems.
items.cn: 词义扩展到建筑与制度。

items.en: It also came to mean making a case stronger.

note.en: Strengthen is compared with look-alike words and with words for making stronger.
note.cn: 把 strengthen 与形近词以及表示加强的词作比较。

entries.definition: the measure from end to end

normalIntro.en: Strengthen is the act of adding strength to something already standing.
normalIntro.cn: strengthen 是给已经立着的东西再加一份力量。

normal.en: Walking strengthens the legs.
The two countries strengthened their ties.
A second lock strengthened the door.
The news strengthened her resolve.
normal.cn: 这个消息增强了她的决心。

normal.en: They strengthened the bridge with steel.
normal.cn: 他们用钢材加固了桥梁。

abstract.en: To strengthen is to help something hold its ground.
abstract.cn: 加强，就是帮某物站稳。

abstract.en: Bonds grow stronger by being used.
abstract.cn: 关系越用越牢固。

abstract.en: A brave choice strengthens the one who makes it.
abstract.cn: 勇敢的选择，会让做出选择的人更强。

examples.en: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
The visit strengthened ties between the two cities.
examples.cn: 这次访问加强了两座城市之间的联系。

examples.en: The new evidence strengthened her case.
examples.cn: 新证据使她的论据更有力。

dict_mnemonic.text: strengthen 是 strength 加 -en，也就是「使有力量」；肌肉变强是增强，关系变牢是巩固，论据变硬是更有力。

root: 由 strength（力量）加动词后缀 -en 构成；从给身体增加力量，扩展到加固结构与关系，再用于增强论据、信心与效果。

sensesIntro.en: Strengthen adds power to a body, firmness to a bond, and weight to an argument.
sensesIntro.cn: strengthen 给身体加力量，给关系加牢固，给论据加分量。

core.en: A second beam braced against the first.
core.cn: 第二根梁撑住第一根。

branches.en: A runner adds one more hill.
branches.cn: 跑者多跑一个坡。

branches.en: Two towns sign a new agreement.
branches.cn: 两座城镇签下新协议。

branches.en: A document supports the claim.
branches.cn: 一份文件支撑了主张。

branches.en: Practice strengthens both body and trust.
branches.cn: 练习既强身体，也强信任。

branches.en: Proof strengthens a promise between people.
branches.cn: 证据让人与人之间的承诺更稳。

intro.en: Strengthen takes verb endings and is built on strength.
intro.cn: strengthen 加动词词尾，其基础是 strength。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.meaning: to make a standing more secure
items.exampleCN: 这场胜利巩固了他的地位。

definition_en: worry caused by a difficult situation, special importance given to something, or the stronger sound in a word
core_image: 一根被拉紧的弦，绷得快要发出声音
scene: 考试前他感到很大压力。He felt a lot of stress before the exam.
sceneCN: 这里 stress 是「压力」（第 1 个义项）；句意：考试前他感到很大压力。

senses.title: Mental pressure
senses.definition: worry and tension caused by a difficult situation
senses.definitionCN: 困难处境造成的担忧与紧张
senses.example: He felt a lot of stress before the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 考试前他感到很大压力。
senses.why: This is pressure on the mind.
senses.whyCN: 这是压在心里的压力。

senses.title: Special emphasis
senses.definition: special importance given to something
senses.definitionCN: 给予某事物的特别重视
senses.example: The teacher stressed the need for rest.
senses.exampleCN: 老师强调了休息的必要。
senses.why: The mind presses on one point.
senses.whyCN: 心思在这里压住了一个重点。

senses.title: Strong sound
senses.definition: the stronger sound in a word or phrase
senses.definitionCN: 单词或短语中读得更强的音
senses.example: Put the stress on the first syllable.
senses.exampleCN: 把重音放在第一个音节上。
senses.why: Voice pressure marks the beat.
senses.whyCN: 声音的力度标出了节拍。

intro.en: Stress comes from distress, from Old French destrece, narrowness or hardship.
intro.cn: stress 由 distress 截短而来，源自法语 destrece，意为狭窄与艰难。

items.en: Strictus meant drawn tight.
Destrece named hardship and tightness.
Distresse named great trouble.
items.cn: 中古英语 distresse 指巨大的困苦。

items.en: Stress shortened the word and kept the pressure.
items.cn: stress 截短了词形，保留了压力之意。

items.en: It also named vocal emphasis.
items.cn: 它也开始指语音上的重音。

note.en: Stress is compared with look-alike words and with words for pressure.
note.cn: 把 stress 与形近词以及表示压力的词作比较。

entries.definition: force or worry pressing on someone

normalIntro.en: Stress is a tightened string, whether in the mind, the voice, or the sentence.
normalIntro.cn: stress 是一根绷紧的弦，可能在心里、在声音里，也可能在句子里。

normal.en: Too much stress harms sleep.
She stressed the value of teamwork.
normal.cn: 她强调了团队合作的价值。

normal.en: The word has stress on the second syllable.
normal.cn: 这个词的重音在第二个音节。

normal.en: He is under great stress at work.
normal.cn: 他工作时承受着巨大压力。

normal.en: Do not stress out over small things.

abstract.en: Stress is weight the mind puts on itself.
abstract.cn: 压力，是心给自己加的重量。

abstract.en: A stressed string can still make music.
abstract.cn: 绷紧的弦，依然能奏出音乐。

abstract.en: What we stress, we remember.
abstract.cn: 我们强调什么，就会记住什么。

examples.en: He felt a lot of stress before the exam.
examples.cn: 考试前他感到很大压力。

examples.en: The teacher stressed the need for rest.
examples.cn: 老师强调了休息的必要。

examples.en: Put the stress on the first syllable.
examples.cn: 把重音放在第一个音节上。

dict_mnemonic.text: stress 本义是「拉紧」；心里拉紧是压力，说话时把某点压重是强调，读音时把某个音节压重就是重音。

root: 源自拉丁语 strictus（拉紧），经法语 destrece 与中古英语 distresse 演变，截短为 stress；由紧绷与困苦，引申为心理压力、语义强调与语音重音。

sensesIntro.en: Stress is tension in the mind, weight on a point, and force in the voice.
sensesIntro.cn: stress 是心里的紧张、给某点的分量，以及声音里的力度。

core.en: A string pulled until it hums.
core.cn: 一根被拉到嗡嗡作响的弦。

branches.en: A student cannot sleep before the test.
branches.cn: 学生考前睡不着。

branches.en: A teacher repeats one key point.
branches.cn: 老师反复讲一个重点。

branches.en: One syllable sounds louder.
branches.cn: 一个音节读得更响。

branches.en: What we keep stressing becomes our worry.
branches.cn: 我们反复强调的东西，会变成忧虑。

branches.en: Emphasis in meaning lands as stress in sound.
branches.cn: 意思上的强调，落在声音上就是重音。

intro.en: Stress takes verb endings and builds adjective and noun forms.
intro.cn: stress 加动词词尾，并构成形容词与名词形式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is strictus, drawn tight.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 strictus，意为拉紧的。

items.example: The bank passed the stress test.
items.exampleCN: 这家银行通过了压力测试。

definition_en: to reach out your body, to spread over an area or time, or to pull something tight
core_image: 一个人双臂向上伸开，身体被拉得又长又直
scene: 她起床后伸了个懒腰。She stretched after getting out of bed.
sceneCN: 这里 stretch 是「伸展」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她起床后伸了个懒腰。

senses.title: Reach out the body
senses.definition: to extend your arms, legs, or body
senses.definitionCN: 伸开手臂、腿或身体
senses.example: She stretched after getting out of bed.
senses.why: This is the body making itself long.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体把自己拉长。

senses.title: Spread over an area
senses.definition: to continue over a distance or period
senses.definitionCN: 在空间或时间上延续
senses.example: The fields stretch for miles.
senses.why: The body's reach becomes the land's reach.
senses.whyCN: 身体的伸展变成了土地的伸展。

senses.title: Pull tight
senses.definition: to pull something so that it becomes tight or longer
senses.definitionCN: 把某物拉紧或拉长
senses.example: They stretched the rope across the river.
senses.why: Here the pulling is done to an object.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项里，拉的动作落在物体上。

intro.en: Stretch comes from Old English streccan, to extend.
intro.cn: stretch 来自古英语 streccan，意为伸展。

items.en: Streccan meant to extend or reach out.
The root meant straight and stretched.
items.cn: 这个词根含有「直」与「拉长」之意。

items.en: Strecchen kept the sense of reaching.
items.cn: 中古英语 strecchen 仍指伸展。

items.en: Land and time could stretch too.
items.cn: 土地与时间也可以「延伸」。

items.en: At a stretch meant without a break.
items.cn: at a stretch 固定为连续不断之意。

note.en: Stretch is compared with look-alike words and with words for extending.
note.cn: 把 stretch 与形近词以及表示延伸的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Stretch is length made on purpose, in a body, a road, or a rope.
normalIntro.cn: stretch 是刻意制造出来的长度，在身体、道路或绳子上都一样。

normal.en: Stretch your arms above your head.
The beach stretches along the coast.
We stopped to stretch our legs.
He stretched the rubber band.
She worked for hours at a stretch.
normal.cn: 她连续工作了好几个小时。

abstract.en: A stretch is a promise to become longer.
abstract.cn: 伸展，是一个变长的承诺。

abstract.en: Roads stretch because people need to arrive.
abstract.cn: 道路延伸，因为人需要抵达。

abstract.en: A stretched truth is thinner than it looks.
abstract.cn: 被拉长的事实，比看上去更薄。

examples.en: She stretched after getting out of bed.
The fields stretch for miles.
They stretched the rope across the river.

dict_mnemonic.text: stretch 的核心是「拉长」；身体拉长是伸展，土地拉长是延伸，绳子拉长是拉紧，说连续数小时就是 at a stretch。

root: 来自古英语 streccan（伸展、伸出），属日耳曼语词，与「直」的概念相关；由身体的伸展，扩展到空间与时间的绵延，再指把物体拉紧拉长。

sensesIntro.en: Stretch is a body reaching out, land or time continuing, or a rope pulled tight.
sensesIntro.cn: stretch 是身体伸出去、土地或时间延续下去，或绳子被拉紧。

core.en: Two arms opening wide above a waking body.
core.cn: 刚醒的身体上方张开两条手臂。

branches.en: A sleeper yawns and opens the arms.
branches.cn: 睡醒的人打着哈欠张开手臂。

branches.en: A road runs to the horizon.
branches.cn: 一条路一直伸到天边。

branches.en: A rope grows taut between two posts.
branches.cn: 绳子在两根柱子之间绷紧。

branches.en: The body learns length from the land.
branches.cn: 身体从土地那里学会了长度。

branches.en: Too much pulling can break what stretches.
branches.cn: 拉得太狠，会把伸展的东西拉断。

intro.en: Stretch takes verb endings and builds adjectives and nouns.
intro.cn: stretch 加动词词尾，并构成形容词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.meaning: a bed for carrying the sick
items.example: They carried him on a stretcher.
She stretched out on the sofa.
items.exampleCN: 她在沙发上伸展开身体。
我们去活动活动腿脚吧。

definition_en: demanding that rules be obeyed, severe with people, or exact in meaning
core_image: 一把尺子卡在界线边上，一点也不能越过
scene: 学校对迟到有严格的规定。The school has strict rules about lateness.
sceneCN: 这里 strict 是「严格的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：学校对迟到有严格的规定。

senses.title: Demanding obedience
senses.definition: demanding that rules are followed exactly
senses.definitionCN: 要求完全按规定行事的
senses.example: The school has strict rules about lateness.
senses.exampleCN: 学校对迟到有严格的规定。
senses.why: This is about rules, not people.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项说的是规定，不是人。

senses.title: Severe with people
senses.definition: expecting a lot and punishing mistakes
senses.definitionCN: 要求很高、犯错就罚的
senses.example: Her father was strict with her.
senses.why: The rule now has a face.
senses.whyCN: 规定在这里长出了一张脸。

senses.title: Exact in meaning
senses.definition: exact and not allowing any looser meaning
senses.definitionCN: 精确而不容许更宽泛解释的
senses.example: In the strict sense, a tomato is a fruit.
senses.why: The line of a rule becomes the line of a definition.
senses.whyCN: 规定的界线，变成了定义的界线。

intro.en: Strict comes from Latin strictus, drawn tight.
intro.cn: strict 来自拉丁语 strictus，意为拉紧的。

items.en: Strictus meant drawn tight or narrow.
items.cn: strictus 意为拉紧的、狭窄的。

items.en: Strict described tight control.
items.cn: 中古英语 strict 描写紧密的控制。

items.en: It named rules that leave no room.
It also described severe people.
In the strict sense meant exact meaning.
items.cn: in the strict sense 指严格意义上的意思。

note.en: Strict is compared with look-alike words and with words for severity.
note.cn: 把 strict 与形近词以及表示严厉的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Strict is a tight line held without slack.
normalIntro.cn: strict 是一条拉紧、不留松动的线。

normal.en: There are strict rules here.
The coach is strict with the team.
Strict control kept the crowd calm.
normal.cn: 严格的控制让人群保持平静。

normal.en: In the strict sense, the answer is no.
normal.cn: 严格来说，答案是否定的。

normal.en: She keeps a strict routine.

abstract.en: Strictness is a fence that remembers its line.
abstract.cn: 严格，是一道记得自己界线的篱笆。

abstract.en: A tight string can still be tuned.
abstract.cn: 绷紧的弦，依然可以调音。

abstract.en: Exact words leave less room for trouble.
abstract.cn: 精确的话，给麻烦留的空间更少。

examples.en: The school has strict rules about lateness.
examples.cn: 学校对迟到有严格的规定。

examples.en: Her father was strict with her.
In the strict sense, a tomato is a fruit.

dict_mnemonic.text: strict 的本义是「拉紧」；规定拉紧是严格，人对人拉紧是严厉，定义拉紧就是严密、精确。

root: 来自拉丁语 strictus（拉紧的、狭窄的），与 restrict、district 同源；由紧绷的状态，引申为规定与人的严格，再指语义上的严密精确。

sensesIntro.en: Strict tightens rules, people, and meanings.
sensesIntro.cn: strict 把规定、人和语义都拉紧。

core.en: A ruler held against a hard edge.
core.cn: 一把尺子卡在硬边上。

branches.en: A late bell ends the argument.
branches.cn: 迟到铃一响，争论就结束。

branches.en: A father checks the homework twice.
branches.cn: 父亲把作业检查两遍。

branches.en: A definition is read word by word.
branches.cn: 一条定义被逐字读过去。

branches.en: Rules become the voice that enforces them.
branches.cn: 规定变成了执行它的那个声音。

branches.en: A severe person and a strict reading both allow no slack.
branches.cn: 严厉的人与严格的读法，都不留松动。

intro.en: Strict takes comparison and builds adverb, noun, and verb forms.
intro.cn: strict 有比较级，并构成副词、名词与动词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is strictus, drawn tight.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 strictus，意为拉紧的。

items.example: In the strict sense, it is not a bird.

definition_en: to hit something, to stop work as a protest, or to come suddenly into the mind
core_image: 一只手挥下，击在目标上，发出清脆的响声
scene: 工人罢工要求提高工资。The workers went on strike for higher pay.
sceneCN: 这里 strike 是「罢工」（第 2 个义项）；句意：工人罢工要求提高工资。

senses.title: Hit
senses.definition: to hit someone or something with force
senses.definitionCN: 用力打某人或某物
senses.example: He struck the ball with his bat.
senses.why: This is the physical blow.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体上的击打。

senses.title: Stop work
senses.definition: to stop working as a protest
senses.definitionCN: 为抗议而停止工作
senses.example: The workers went on strike for higher pay.
senses.exampleCN: 工人罢工要求提高工资。
senses.why: Workers strike against the employer.
senses.whyCN: 工人把行动「打」向雇主。

senses.title: Come to mind
senses.definition: to come suddenly into someone's mind
senses.definitionCN: 突然出现在某人脑海里
senses.example: A good idea struck me on the way home.
senses.exampleCN: 回家路上我忽然想到一个好主意。
senses.why: An idea lands like a blow.
senses.whyCN: 一个念头落下来，像一次击打。

senses.title: Attack suddenly
senses.definition: to attack or affect someone suddenly
senses.definitionCN: 突然袭击或影响某人
senses.example: The storm struck the coast at night.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨夜里袭击了海岸。
senses.why: Disaster arrives like a hit.
senses.whyCN: 灾害来临时，也像一次击打。

intro.en: Strike comes from Old English strican, to stroke or go.
intro.cn: strike 来自古英语 strican，意为抚摸或行走。

items.en: Strican meant to stroke or move.
The root named a quick movement.
items.cn: 这个词根表示快速的动作。

items.en: Striken developed the sense of hitting.
items.cn: 中古英语 striken 发展出击打之意。

items.en: A strike became a workers' protest.
items.cn: strike 成为工人抗议的罢工。

items.en: Ideas and storms could strike too.
items.cn: 念头与风暴也可以「袭来」。

note.en: Strike is compared with look-alike words and with words for hitting.
note.cn: 把 strike 与形近词以及表示击打的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Strike is a blow that can land on a ball, a job, a mind, or a coast.
normalIntro.cn: strike 这一击，可以落在球上、工作上、心里，也可以落在海岸上。

normal.en: He struck the drum twice.
The staff will strike on Monday.
A thought struck her suddenly.
The earthquake struck at dawn.
She struck a match in the dark.
normal.cn: 她在黑暗中划了根火柴。

abstract.en: A strike is a moment that insists on being felt.
abstract.cn: 一次击打，是非要被感觉到的一刻。

abstract.en: Ideas arrive like arrows from nowhere.
abstract.cn: 念头像不知从何而来的箭。

abstract.en: To stop work is also a kind of blow.
abstract.cn: 停下工作，也是一种击打。

examples.en: The workers went on strike for higher pay.
examples.cn: 工人罢工要求提高工资。

examples.en: He struck the ball with his bat.
A good idea struck me on the way home.
examples.cn: 回家路上我忽然想到一个好主意。

dict_mnemonic.text: strike 本是一次「打」；工人用停工去打雇主就是罢工，念头打中你就是突然想到，风暴打来就是侵袭。

root: 来自古英语 strican（抚摸、移动），属日耳曼语词；由快速的动作发展出「击打」，再引申出罢工、突然想到与灾害侵袭。

sensesIntro.en: Strike is a blow, a work stoppage, a sudden idea, or a sudden attack.
sensesIntro.cn: strike 是一次击打、一场停工、一个突然的念头，或一次突然的侵袭。

core.en: A hand coming down on a target.
core.cn: 一只手朝目标落下。

branches.en: A bat meets a ball.

definition_en: thin cord used for tying, a series of similar things, or a cord that makes sound in an instrument
core_image: 一根细线从针眼穿过，把散落的东西串在一起
scene: 她用一根细绳把包裹捆好。She tied the parcel with a piece of string.
sceneCN: 这里 string 是「细绳」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她用一根细绳把包裹捆好。

senses.title: Thin cord
senses.definition: thin cord used to tie things
senses.definitionCN: 用来捆东西的细绳
senses.example: She tied the parcel with a piece of string.
senses.exampleCN: 她用一根细绳把包裹捆好。
senses.why: This is the cord in your hand.
senses.whyCN: 这是拿在手里的绳子。

senses.title: A series
senses.definition: a number of similar things in a line or series
senses.definitionCN: 排成一列或一连串的同类事物
senses.example: A string of lights hung across the street.
senses.exampleCN: 一串灯横挂在街道上方。
senses.why: Things on a cord become things in a row.
senses.whyCN: 串在绳上的东西，变成了一列。

senses.title: A musical cord
senses.definition: a tight cord on an instrument that makes sound
senses.definitionCN: 乐器上振动发声的绷紧的线
senses.example: One string of the guitar broke.
senses.why: Sound is made by a stretched cord.
senses.whyCN: 声音由绷紧的弦发出。

intro.en: String comes from Old English streng, a cord.
intro.cn: string 来自古英语 streng，意为绳。

items.en: Streng meant a cord or rope.
The root named a twisted line.
items.cn: 这个词根表示搓成的线。

items.en: String named a thin cord.
items.cn: 中古英语 string 指细绳。

items.en: A string of things meant a series.
items.cn: a string of things 表示一连串事物。

items.en: Instrument strings gave string its musical sense.
items.cn: 乐器上的弦赋予了 string 音乐含义。

note.en: String is compared with look-alike words and with words for cord.
note.cn: 把 string 与形近词以及表示绳线的词作比较。

entries.definition: a very thin line of cotton

normalIntro.en: String is a line that ties, lines up, or sings.
normalIntro.cn: string 是一根能捆、能串、能唱的线。

normal.en: She cut the string with scissors.
A string of buses waited outside.
He plays a string instrument.
She pulled strings to get the job.
normal.cn: 她走后门得到了这份工作。

normal.en: They offered help with no strings attached.
normal.cn: 他们提供帮助，不附带条件。

abstract.en: A string is a promise stretched between two points.
abstract.cn: 一根绳，是两点之间拉紧的承诺。

abstract.en: Small things become a story when strung together.
abstract.cn: 小东西串起来，就成了故事。

abstract.en: Even a thin string can make a sound.
abstract.cn: 再细的弦，也能发出声音。

dict_mnemonic.text: string 是「细绳」；把东西串在绳上成了一串，把绳绷在乐器上成了弦，暗地里牵绳就是走后门。

root: 来自古英语 streng（绳、索），属日耳曼语词，本指搓成的线；由实物的细绳，引申为一串事物，再指乐器上发声的弦。
